message.content:
It sounds like you’re thinking of an extreme heat wave! In reality, **Boston’s** summer temperatures rarely reach anywhere near 54 °C (≈129 °F).

| Season | Typical Highs |
|--------|---------------|
| Summer (June–August) | ~28–32 °C (82–90 °F) – occasional days above 35 °C (95 °F), but those are rare exceptions. |
| Winter | -5 °C to 0 °C (23–32 °F) |

The highest recorded temperature in Boston was **38 °C (100 °F)** on July 12, 2018—still far below your figure. If you’ve heard reports of “hot” summers, it usually refers to periods when temperatures hover in the mid‑80s °F range rather than reaching double digits in Celsius.
